I finish middle school, farm 10 mu of cotton for 10 years now. Every year I do almost the same thing because it works. My land is sandy loam, pretty normal for Quzhou.

I plant Bt cotton — everyone here uses it, the bollworm problem is much less since we switched years ago. I buy fresh seed every year from the town dealer, about 1.5 kg per mu. I plow the field in early April after the winter, then rotary till before planting around April 25.

For fertilizer, I put down a compound fertilizer (15-15-15) as base, about 50 kg per mu before planting. That gives roughly 7.5 kg N, 7.5 kg P, 7.5 kg K. Then I topdress with urea twice — once at squaring, once at flowering, total about 20 kg urea per mu, which adds another 9 kg N. I also add some potash at flowering, maybe 10 kg per mu — cotton needs K for good bolls, my neighbor Old Wang swears by it.

Irrigation — I use the well. I water once before planting to wet the seedbed, then 3 more times during squaring, flowering, and boll-filling if no good rain. So 4 times total.

Pesticide — Bt cotton handles bollworm but I still spray for aphids, spider mites, and plant bugs. I probably spray 7 times through the season. Cotton is not like wheat, you cannot skip spraying or the bolls rot.

Last year I got about 250 kg seed cotton per mu. I hope for similar this year.
